page_title: EMP 0-1 ROM | Empoli v AS Roma 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
90+3' AS Roma take a short corner kick.
90+2' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. AS Roma will take a corner kick.
90+2' AS Roma work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

90+1' Lovely run from Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball. AS Roma force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Angelino (AS Roma) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies well wide of the right post.
89' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
89' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. AS Roma force a corner. They send men into the box.
86' Substitution. Saba Goglichidze will be replaced by Thomas Campaniello (Empoli).
84' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Marco Silvestri.
83' The referee awards a corner and Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) goes over to take it.
82' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) makes a rough challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
81' Substitution. Matias Soule did his best and is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
79' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ismael Konate (Empoli).
78' AS Roma win a corner.
77' Manu Kone (AS Roma) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) comes onto the pitch for Eldor Shomurodov.
70' The foul by Ismael Konate (Empoli) was seen by Marco Di Bello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
66' Sebastiano Esposito will be replaced by Ismael Konate (Empoli).
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Liam Henderson will be replaced by Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli).
66' Matias Soule (AS Roma) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
65' Claudio Ranieri prepares a substitution. Leandro Paredes is replaced by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma).
65' Here is a change. Anass Salah-Eddine is going off and Claudio Ranieri gives the last tactical orders to Angelino (AS Roma).
64' Substitution. Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) in, Saud Abdulhamid out.
64' Matias Soule (AS Roma) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.
63' Liam Henderson (Empoli) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Marco Di Bello stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick to AS Roma.
63' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
62' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

62' The linesman points to the corner flag, AS Roma are going to take it. Marco Silvestri pulls off a brilliant save! Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved.
61' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
58' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
56' There's an opportunity for Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
55' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Matias Soule (AS Roma). The ball is out of play and AS Roma manage to earn a corner.
53' Manu Kone (AS Roma) picks up a rebound in space and tries his luck from long range, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
48' A pass by Saud Abdulhamid (AS Roma) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' Roberto D'Aversa makes a half-time substitution. Junior Sambia comes on in place of Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli).
46' The game is over for Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli). Junior Sambia comes on for the second half.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
42' Liam Henderson (Empoli) commits a rough challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for an infringement.

40' What a chance that is! Manu Kone (AS Roma) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the right post!
38' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
37' OFF THE BAR! Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and fires a bullet of a shot that crashes against the crossbar.
33' Anass Salah-Eddine (AS Roma) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The linesman signals a throw-in for AS Roma.
32' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) sends a long ball forward to Lorenzo Colombo, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
30' Poor challenge! Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) is penalised for tripping and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle.
27' Manu Kone (AS Roma) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
26' The game is interrupted now, Manu Kone (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Empoli are ruled offside.
23' Eldor Shomurodov plays a lovely pass into Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post.
20' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
16' Liam Henderson (Empoli) jumps into a tackle and Marco Di Bello signals a foul.
13' The game is interrupted as Manu Kone (AS Roma) is flagged offside.
8' The referee points to the corner flag and Empoli will take a corner.

7' Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Mile Svilar. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Empoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
3' Victor Nelsson (AS Roma) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
1' 0 - 1 Goal! Matias Soule (AS Roma) is teed up on the edge of the box by Anass Salah-Eddine, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:1.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Empoli will take the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello is the one to supervise the game today.
